name: theme
does: Dark colours for the whole page, and the student's own choice of Match device (the default: the phone's or computer's light or dark setting), Light or Dark, in the header and in Settings. The choice is a setting of the device, kept in this browser for every profile and not in the progress. Reads no course data.
